name: Jafurah Gas Plant Export Pipeline (Package 5)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Jafurah Gas Field Development Phase 1 Package 5 Export Pipelines; Jafurah Gas Plant Package 5 Export Pipeline
values.RouteNotes: New-build ~349 km sales-gas export line from the Jafurah Gas Plant (Al Harmaliyah area, Eastern Province) tying into the Master Gas System / national grid; no official GIS route located, endpoint node into MGS not yet confirmed.

researcher_notes: MATCH-TO-EXISTING re-checked: no existing GEM Saudi gas row named Jafurah (65 SA gas rows reviewed). Should NOT fold into P5885 (MGS III Gas Pipelines, segments P6717-P6737) -- that is the separate Master Gas System Phase III program; this is a distinct EPC package (Package 5) under Saudi Aramco's Jafurah Gas Field Development Phase 1, a ~349 km sales-gas EXPORT line from the Jafurah Gas Plant into the national grid/MGS. ADD-THRESHOLD met on all three legs: (a) sponsor = Saudi Aramco (dmsprojects, protenders); (b) country + start endpoint = Jafurah Gas Plant, Al Harmaliyah / Eastern Province (metenders, protenders); (c) concrete step = EPC contract awarded July 2024 as part of Aramco's $25bn Jafurah/MGS III awards (saudigulfprojects, metenders). STATUS operating: Jafurah Phase 1 came onstream Dec 2025 at ~450 MMcf/d sales gas (Argus, JPT/SPE), and dmsprojects lists Package 5 Export Pipelines as 'Completed' -- the export line must be carrying that Phase 1 sales gas. CONFIDENCE: existence + sponsor + operating status are HIGH (independent: Aramco program coverage via Argus and JPT/SPE, plus multiple project DBs). The 349 km LENGTH is medium -- it appears only in tender/project-tracking databases (metenders/dmsprojects/protenders/bncnetwork) that may share a common tender origin, so treat as single-tier pending a second truly independent figure. Diameter and pipeline design capacity NOT found -> left blank (450 MMcf/d is plant output, not a verified pipeline rating; not entered). ROUTE: no official GIS located; corridor Jafurah plant (Eastern Province) -> MGS/national grid; specific MGS tie-in node unconfirmed, so End location left blank and RouteType/RouteAccuracy left blank (no fabricated coords). Aramco.com $25bn contract-awards page repeatedly timed out in url_verifier and is therefore NOT cited. Saudi Aramco entity already exists in the gas tracker (entity_lookup: 'Aramco'/'Saudi Aramco' 100% match) -- no new entity created.
